purpose: The published map is one draw (placement quirk seed 1, size residual seed 1). Show which proposed-town positions recur across draws and how much each town's size varies, so a proposed town reads as a likelihood, not a prediction.
method: Corrected and raw climates. For seeds 1-40: release-3 placement (prior tiling, heartland prior, count matched to the production count) with placement seed s; sizes by a replica of the published builder (hinterlands, M1 + 0.8 for the 19 seats, settlement hierarchy with phi 0.5, residual seed s, lore order A3, capital rule). Replica check: seed 1 must reproduce the published positions exactly and the published areas to 1e-9.
outputs: Per climate: recurrence grid (share of seeds with a proposed town within one cell, about 9 km); per marked place the 10th, 50th and 90th percentile of residents (sliding density); summary of how many recurrence hotspots (>= 0.5) exist. Published as an extra Settlements option ('Proposed towns: recurrence over 40 draws'); the default draw is unchanged.
